author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@lonseidman I will never see gigabit service in East Haddam. Our last mile will never have fiber. It barely works now.

I also find the lower upstream to be a bit strange? I know the Tos probably doesn't allow runnign servers but they could bump that a bit.

I think what CT needs to do is invest in municipal wifi. We have let the telcoms strangle us for too long.
